edge-cases/SC_2026-09_misprinted-balance.why: Row 7's printed balance is off by S$1.00: that row and the next both fail the running-balance check.

edge-cases/PayLah_2026-09_missing-row.pd.why: One row is missing from the table, so previous balance + rows no longer equals the carried-forward balance.

edge-cases/POSB_2026-09_password-MOCK123.why: Password-protected. The page should ask for the password (MOCK1234) and then parse cleanly; a wrong password re-prompts.

edge-cases/Scanned_photo_no-text-layer.p.why: Image-only PDF with no text layer; the log should say OCR isn't supported.

edge-cases/Unknown_bank_statement.pdf.why: Not one of the supported banks; the log should show the first lines it read.

edge-cases/Not_actually_a_PDF.pdf.why: Not a valid PDF; pdf.js should fail to open it and the log should say so.

notes: Load all 9 files in /mocks (not edge-cases) together: every file should be 'clean' with all balance checks green.
The SAYE section is quarter-to-date, so 6 SAYE rows repeat across files and should be reported as counted once.
PayLah statements run 23rd -> 22nd, so the July file also contains late-June rows.
SC card purchases post 0-2 days after purchase, so a few late-September purchases are not in any statement (realistic).
Internal transfers that should be excluded from spending: PayLah top-ups (POSB out / PayLah in), monthly S$1,500 POSB -> SC, SAYE S$300, DBS credit card bill payment.
Deliberately uncategorised merchants: ATM WITHDRAWAL, SHENG HUAT HARDWARE, ACME TECH salary is categorised as Salary.
